### nativeGitMethodNameSchema

```ts
const nativeGitMethodNameSchema: ZodEnum<{
  info: "info";
  create: "create";
  log: "log";
  delete: "delete";
  exchange: "exchange";
  fork: "fork";
  cloneUrl: "cloneUrl";
  readCommit: "readCommit";
  readTree: "readTree";
  readBlob: "readBlob";
  refs: "refs";
}>;
```

Native method identity is a source-owned refinement, not a transport parser.

## Functions

### invokeNativeGit()

```ts
function invokeNativeGit(
  git,
  method,
  raw,
): Promise<
  | string
  | boolean
  | Uint8Array<ArrayBufferLike>
  | object[]
  | Readonly<{
      status: number;
      headers: Readonly<Record<string, string>>;
      body: Uint8Array;
    }>
  | Readonly<{
      name: string;
      defaultBranch: string;
      lastPushAt: string | null;
      source: string | null;
    }>
  | Readonly<{
      hash: string;
      treeHash: string;
      message: string;
      author: {
        name: string;
        email: string;
      };
      committer: {
        name: string;
        email: string;
      };
      parents: string[];
      authoredAt: number;
      committedAt: number;
    }>
  | Readonly<{
      hash: string;
      treeHash: string;
      message: string;
      author: {
        name: string;
        email: string;
      };
      committer: {
        name: string;
        email: string;
      };
      parents: string[];
      authoredAt: number;
      committedAt: number;
    }>[]
  | Readonly<{
      name: string;
      mode: string;
      hash: string;
      type: "blob" | "tree" | "commit";
    }>[]
  | null
>;
```

Dispatch owned tuples through the retained native handle without a JSON
conversion.
